xar_select_contract_conqueror_effect = {
	set_global_variable = { name = xa_contract_id value = 1 }
	set_global_variable = { name = xa_contract_progress value = 0 }
	# XAR_ACCEPTANCE_ONLY_BEGIN
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = xa_full_ui_test_active }
		if = { limit = { global_var:xa_contract_id = 1 } debug_log = "XAR: TEST PASS ui_contract_select" }
		else = { debug_log = "XAR: TEST FAIL ui_contract_select" }
		remove_global_variable = xa_full_ui_test_active
		remove_global_variable = xa_ui_test_stage
	}
	# XAR_ACCEPTANCE_ONLY_END
}
